public_rationale: OpenAI reported functioning Jalapeño engineering samples on June 24, 2026. That contradicts the prediction that OpenAI and Broadcom would not build their ASIC in 2026 under the ordinary reading of producing working silicon. The separate question about production quantities remains unanswered by this evidence.
limitations: The decisive evidence is a company disclosure, not an independently reproduced hardware test.
If 'build' requires commercial-scale deployment, this evidence would not settle that narrower interpretation.

statement.excerpt: When? Say OpenAI and Broadcom actually build their ASIC in 2026 (they won't) — how many of them will they build?
statement.document_title: The Hater's Guide To The AI Bubble

our_interpretation: Read 'build' as producing functional physical silicon for their joint custom AI accelerator.
A functioning engineering sample counts. A design announcement or manufacturing tape-out alone does not.
The following question about quantities treats scale as a separate issue; the forecast does not explicitly require mass production or commercial deployment.
criteria.support_condition: After December 31, 2026, reliable evidence establishes that no functional joint ASIC was produced during 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable dated evidence establishes that functional physical samples of the joint custom AI ASIC existed during 2026.
